verdict.rationale: The first-party docs say LM Studio serves local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and over the network. The CLI documents `lms server start` and `lms load`, the server can load models on demand at request time, and community users confirm the OpenAI-compatible server makes it easy to spin up and test models. Missing for 10: detailed endpoint-level documentation of OpenAI compatibility (e.g., which routes are supported) in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: Serve local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network
Start and stop the local server ... lms server start / lms server stop
to use a model, simply send an inferencing request to it. If the model is not yet loaded, it'll be loaded before your request returns.
the OpenAI server makes it really easy to spin up a server and test
